samples.name: schema_migration_critical_service
samples.description: Schema change on payment-service (critical tier) → should classify high/critical

change.title: Add NOT NULL constraint to payment_methods.user_id
change.description: Adds NOT NULL constraint to user_id column on payment_methods table. Requires backfilling ~500K rows with default user_id derived from billing_account. Migration locks table briefly during ALTER. Rollback: DROP CONSTRAINT.

expectations.label: schema change on critical service → high or critical risk

samples.name: readonly_staging_low_risk
samples.description: Read-only config in staging → should classify low

change.title: Increase log verbosity on search-service in staging
change.description: Bumps LOG_LEVEL env var from INFO to DEBUG on search-service staging instances only. No code change. No persistent state change. Reverted by setting env var back to INFO and rolling pods.

expectations.label: staging config change → low or medium risk

samples.name: no_rollback_production_critical
samples.description: Production change with no rollback plan on critical service → critical risk

change.title: Drop deprecated columns from identity-service users table
change.description: Drops 4 deprecated columns (legacy_oauth_token, old_email, signup_referrer, legacy_role_id) from users table on identity-service. Irreversible — columns and data lost. No rollback plan documented.

expectations.label: irreversible production change → high or critical
